title: On h-Open Sets in Relator Spaces
content: We introduce and investigate a relator-theoretic version of h-open sets. A relator space is a pair X(R) = (X,R), where R is a nonempty family of binary relations on X. Relator spaces provide a common framework for uniform spaces, ordered structures, generalized topological spaces and several relational constructions. We define the relator interior and use it to introduce h-open subsets relative to a relator. We establish basic permanence properties, characterize the associated h-interior, and give sufficient conditions under which the family of all relator h-open sets forms a topology. We further show that the construction contains the classical theory of h-open sets as a special case. Several examples demonstrate the distinction between ordinary relator openness and h-openness. Finally, we discuss monotone relator maps and the behavior of h-open sets under inverse images. The results suggest that the h-construction is naturally viewed as an operation on relational structures rather than only on ordinary topological spaces.
